reviewed_by: Gemini Pro blind reviewer, batch G3-DP-Harden (mat_g3_dp_q3_0..mat_g3_dp_q3_4), 2026-08-17

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The samples directly ask students to complete data presentation structures matching the curriculum requirements, such as 'Complete the table to show: cats: 5, dogs: 60, birds: 25, fish: 20.' and 'Create a vertical bar graph to show: basketball: 60, volleyball: 65, swimming: 15, running: 40.'.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: All parts of the competency are covered. Tables are covered (e.g., 'Complete the table to show: Monday: 55, Tuesday: 50, Wednesday: 45, Thursday: 60.'), vertical bar graphs are covered (e.g., 'Create a vertical bar graph to show: Grade 1: 15, Grade 2: 30, Grade 3: 45, Grade 4: 60.'), and horizontal bar graphs are covered (e.g., 'Create a horizontal bar graph to show: basketball: 30, volleyball: 55, swimming: 40, running: 15.').

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The categories are familiar to third graders (pets, sports, days, grades) and the numerical values are within a suitable range (e.g., multiples of 5 up to 95, as seen in 'January: 45, February: 65, March: 35, April: 20, May: 55, June: 95.'). This fits well within Grade 3 Quarter 3 capacity.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The samples feature a wide variety of thematic contexts (animals, sports, school grades, months, flowers, days) and vary the length of the data sets (from 4 items to 6 items, as seen in 'Complete the table to show: roses: 30, sunflowers: 60, tulips: 30, daisies: 70, lilies: 10, orchids: 65.').

competency_alignment.rationale: The generated tasks are strictly aligned with the exact language of 'Present data in tables and single bar graphs'. They do not introduce out-of-scope concepts like double bar graphs, line graphs, or probability, maintaining tight alignment.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The generation framework successfully scales across multiple presentation modes (tables, horizontal graphs, vertical graphs), varying data array lengths, and numeric distributions without repeating exact questions, ensuring high replayability.
